A bird flew it up into the sky

title: Pip's Lost Compass
storyPassage: Pip the owl dropped his shiny brass compass in the autumn leaves. Feeling worried, he asked his squirrel neighbor Sammy for help. Together, they gently raked the leaves aside and spotted the gold dial twinkling in the sunlight.
question: What helped Pip find his compass when he felt worried?

choices.text: Buying a new compass at the mall

hint: Asking a friend for help turned worry into a happy solution!
explanation: Exactly! When we feel worried, asking a caring friend brings a happy outcome!
